Our Story

A Name Panipat Trusts for Fine Jewellery

Oberoi Jewels — by Raj Oberoi — is one of Panipat's well-known jewellery showrooms. We believe in unique jewellery designs inspired by culture, belief and innovation.

From daily-wear gold to elaborate bridal sets, our collection is designed for families who value both heritage and modern elegance — visit our HUDA Sector 11 showroom to see it in person.
